row.body: The map shows a farm track ending at a thick road-closure bar. The keyring lies beyond it, tied to a tag stamped “county return.” Beside the bar, “all clear” is checked although the road is still crossed out.
row.title: The key past the closure bar

sidecar.gloss: A county access key and a closure record contradict each other.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm worker could mark a temporary gate closure and reclaim a county key after a shift; a crossed-out route does not prove an official evacuation failure.

row.body: seed husks cling to the duct tape, while bleach marks the empty garden sprayer. road mud joins the two in one tied bundle.
row.title: two traces on the duct tape

sidecar.gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
sidecar.rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.

row.body: The seed bag is folded shut around the shovel handle. A straight line of dark soil runs from the blade to the bag's seam, but the shovel has no soil on its grip.
row.title: The seed bag holds a narrow trench

sidecar.gloss: Seed stock and a freshly used tool were wrapped together.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response crew could move seed stock and tools while clearing a farm; the clean grip could come from ordinary handling.
